head_commit.message:
Integrate qualified Bardwell shoulder repair with current DEV

Import the exact eight Bardwell source/web exports from successful canonical
run39736567239 at96c4da4b, preserve the complete16-file measurement subset and
all existing fixture bytes, and bind his Wolf Point standing instance to the
new qualified files. Preserve newer DEV source/license additions and regenerate
shared source-use/index products through their supported producers.

Keep reconstructed identity and appearance explicit. This initial visible
placement does not close photographic tailoring, skin/hair, full fit or occupied
transport scope. Current-head town and remote coverage remain required before
ordinary DEV merge.
